fullContent:
Lashunadya Ghrita – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – AFI, part – 1, first edition. 
 Introduction 
 Lashunadya Ghrita is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to prepare from the mixture of fruitful herbs. In this formulation ghee (clarified butter) is used as a base. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Lasuna kanda (Allium Sativum) – 4.8 g 
 
 Following ingredients up to 240 grams:- 
 
 Bilva ‎(Aegle marmelos) 
 Syonaka (Oroxylum indicum) 
 Gambhari (Gmelina Arborea) 
 Patala (Cocculus hirsutus) 
 Agnimantha (Clerodendrum phlomidis) 
 Water for decoction 
 
 Following ingredients up to 6 litre:- 
 
 Dadima svarasa (punica granatum’s juice) 
 Sura 
 Dhanyamla 
 Dadhi – 6 kg 
 
 Following ingredients up to 24 grams:- 
 
 Sunthi (Zingiber officinale) 
 Marica (piper nigrum) 
 Pippali (piper longum) 
 Haritkai (Terminalia Chebula) 
 Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) 
 Amalaki (Phyllanthus Emblica) 
 Hingu Ferula narthex 
 Yavani (Carum copticum) 
 Dipyaka 
 Amlavetasa (Garcinia pedunculata) 
 Cavya 
 Sindhutta 
 Devdaaru (Cedrus dcodara) 
 Ghee – 768 grams 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Took all the ingredients in its appropriate quantity and mixed with ghee. 
 Now cooked the ingredients by collecting in a container till herbal ghee preparation. 
 
 Dose 
 Up to 12 grams 
 Indications 
 
 Vata related disorders 
 Flatulence 
 Bloating 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
